title: Mesotherapy in Dubai (Sobha Hartland) | SOLAR
descr: Mesotherapy in Dubai at a licensed clinic in Sobha Hartland. Face, hair, neck and hands, with a needle free option. Free consultation.

hero.9: Micro-injections and needle free · doctor-supervised · Dubai (Sobha Hartland)
hero.8: Mesotherapy in Dubai (Sobha Hartland) - Hydration, Glow and Density, Delivered Into the Skin
hero.7: Mesotherapy places vitamins, amino acids, hyaluronic acid and other actives exactly where they work: in the layer of skin that creams cannot reach. At SOLAR you can have it with micro-needles or completely without needles, for the face, the neck and decolletage, the hands and the scalp.
hero.1: Dermapen micro-injections or needle free Dermadrop TDA
hero.0: Face, neck, decolletage, hands, hair. 45-60 minutes, back to your day the same afternoon.

what.10: Mesotherapy is a method, not a single product.
what.9: A tailored cocktail of hyaluronic acid, vitamins, amino acids, peptides or polynucleotides is delivered into the upper layers of the skin in very small doses, spread over many points. Two things happen at once: the skin receives the actives directly, and the micro-channels themselves trigger the natural repair response that thickens and firms the tissue. Mesolifting is the same method used with lifting-oriented cocktails and a denser point pattern, most often on the face and neck.
what.7: The actives go where they work
what.6: A serum applied on top of the skin stops at the barrier. Mesotherapy crosses that barrier, so hydration and nutrition reach the living layers instead of evaporating from the surface.
what.3: Each micro-channel is a controlled signal. In response the skin produces its own collagen and elastin over the following weeks, which is why the result keeps improving after the session, not only on the day.
what.0: Injectable mesotherapy uses a Dermapen device with fine sterile needles. Needle free mesotherapy uses Dermadrop TDA, which pushes the actives through the barrier with pressure and oxygen instead. SOLAR offers both, so a fear of needles is not a reason to skip the method.

benefits.13: Why the method has stayed in aesthetic medicine for decades while trends came and went.
benefits.10: Hyaluronic acid delivered into the skin holds water from the inside. Dry, tight, dull skin usually changes within the first two sessions.
benefits.7: The micro-channel response builds collagen gradually, so fine lines soften and pores look tighter without adding volume or changing your features.
benefits.3: Face, neck and decolletage, the backs of the hands and the scalp all respond to the same principle with a different cocktail.
benefits.0: Light redness for a few hours, sometimes into the next morning. No peeling, no bandages, makeup the following day.

whyTitle.1: Injections only under a doctor's supervision
whyTitle.0: Mesotherapy is a medical procedure: the cocktail, the depth and the indication are a doctor's decision, not a menu choice.

whyCards.9: SOLAR is a licensed medical facility in Sobha Hartland, not a salon: sterile single-use consumables, medical records and a doctor in the room.
whyCards.6: The skin or scalp is assessed by a certified GP doctor with over 15 years of experience before the first session, contraindications are checked and the course is planned. If you are looking for the best mesotherapy in Dubai, start with the consultation: it is free.
whyCards.3: Genosys, polynucleotides, exosome complexes and PRX are certified products with a traceable batch, chosen for your indication rather than sold as a package.
whyCards.0: Needle length, number of passes and the interval between sessions are set for your skin type and zone. The needle free Dermadrop TDA route is offered where it suits the goal or the client.

evTitle.0: Mesotherapy and microneedling have been studied for skin quality and for the scalp. The evidence base is smaller than for fillers, and the honest summary is that results are consistent but moderate.

evCards.12: Randomized and split-face studies of intradermal hyaluronic acid report improvement in hydration, elasticity and skin roughness compared with untreated skin or with topical application alone.
evCards.7: Controlled studies of microneedling describe improvement in skin texture, fine lines and atrophic scars after a course of sessions, with the effect building over the weeks that follow.
evCards.2: Trials of scalp mesotherapy and microneedling, alone or combined with standard hair loss therapy, report increases in hair count and density, with the combination generally performing better than either approach on its own.
evCards.0: The studies refer to the method (mesotherapy and microneedling), not to a specific clinic. Results are individual and depend on the initial condition, the cocktail and the course.

indTitle.0: From dull, tired skin to hair density.

indItems.3: Recovery after flights and the Dubai climate
indItems.0: Not sure which zone to start with? The 3D Skin Test Janus III shows hydration, pigment and pore condition before anything is planned. For hair, see Hair Loss Treatment.

steps.13: The doctor examines the skin or scalp, discusses your goal and decides whether injectable or needle free mesotherapy fits you better.
steps.9: The 3D Skin Test Janus III (30 minutes) records hydration, pigment, pores and sensitivity so the course can be compared against a starting point.
steps.5: Cleansing, then topical anaesthetic if you have the injectable route. Dermapen passes over the zone in a set pattern with the chosen cocktail. 45-60 minutes.
steps.1: Usually 4-6 sessions every 2-3 weeks, then maintenance every few months. The doctor reviews the skin during the course and adjusts the cocktail if needed.
steps.0: Good to know: for 24 hours avoid sport, sauna, pool and makeup; use sunscreen for the following week. This protects the fresh micro-channels while they close.

priceTitle.0: The price depends on the cocktail, the zones and the number of sessions, and is agreed at the free doctor's consultation. Message us on WhatsApp.

results.6: Redness settles and the skin looks fresher and better hydrated. This is the first, mostly surface-level effect.
results.3: Collagen produced in response to the session starts to show: firmer texture, tighter pores, softer fine lines.
results.0: Four to six sessions give a cumulative change in skin quality that holds for several months. Scalp protocols are judged at three months, when the new growth cycle becomes visible.

faq: Does it hurt, and is there an option without needles?

The Dermapen route is done under topical anaesthetic and feels like light vibration and scratching rather than pain. If needles are a hard no for you, Dermadrop TDA delivers the same kind of actives with pressure and oxygen instead, with no injections at all. Having both under one roof is the reason most needle-averse clients still get a result here.
How many sessions do I need?

Usually 4-6 sessions every 2-3 weeks, then maintenance every three to six months. One session before an event gives glow; skin quality changes over a course. The cost of the course depends on the cocktail and the zones and is agreed at the free consultation.
How is mesotherapy different from skin boosters?

Skin boosters are a few deep deposits of a dense hyaluronic acid gel that hydrate over months. Mesotherapy is many shallow points of a lighter cocktail that also stimulates repair through the micro-channels. Boosters are about reservoir hydration, mesotherapy is about skin quality and can be tuned with different actives, including for the scalp.
When will I see the result?
Freshness within two to three days, collagen-driven firmness from around three to four weeks, the full change after the course.
Can it be done in summer?
Yes, with sunscreen and sensible sun habits for the following week. Mesotherapy is not a peel and does not remove the outer layer, so it is one of the safer options for the Dubai summer.
What is the price of mesotherapy in Dubai?
The price depends on the zones, the protocol and the number of sessions you need. It is agreed at the free consultation with the doctor, before anything is booked, and there are no hidden extras.

cost:
How much does mesotherapy cost in Dubai?

At SOLAR in Dubai the mesotherapy price depends on the cocktail and on how many zones are treated in one visit. The doctor recommends the protocol after examining your skin or scalp, and the plan and price are agreed at a free consultation, before anything is booked.

  • Dermapen Genosys Mesotherapy. Face, face and neck, or face, neck and decolletage. The classic hydration and glow protocol.
  • Dermapen PDNR, polynucleotides. Face, face and neck, or face, neck and decolletage. For thin, tired or depleted skin.
  • Dermapen Exosomes ASCE. Face, neck, decolletage, hands and hair. The most advanced cocktail we offer, and the choice for hair mesotherapy in Dubai.
  • Dermapen PRX, face. Glow before an event, with no visible recovery.
  • Needle free mesotherapy Dermadrop TDA. No needles at all, suitable for sensitive or reactive skin.
  • 3D Skin Test Janus III, 30 minutes. Optional diagnostics to measure the starting point.

What changes the price

  • Cocktail: polynucleotides and exosome complexes cost more than a classic vitamin and hyaluronic acid mix because the active itself costs more.
  • Zones: adding the neck or the decolletage to the face costs less than treating them separately later.
  • Needles or needle free: the Dermadrop TDA route is the gentler and more affordable entry point, the Dermapen route is the stronger one.
  • Course or single session: a single session gives glow, a course of 4-6 changes skin quality. The doctor will say honestly which one your skin needs.

There are no hidden extras: the consultation is free and the full cost of the course is agreed with you before the first session.

Mesotherapy near you

The clinic is in Sobha Hartland, Mohammed Bin Rashid City - 220 m from the bus stop and with free parking, so it is an easy drive from most of central Dubai:

Sobha Hartland - on site · Business Bay - ~10 min · Downtown Dubai - ~12 min · Dubai Creek Harbour - ~12 min · Meydan - ~8 min · Ras Al Khor - ~10 min · Al Jaddaf - ~10 min

Message us on WhatsApp and we will suggest a time that fits your route.
